verification_scope: Top-level checks, coaching_review_workflow, failed_third_down_review and image_freshness describe the current build. Other named UI blocks are historical release records.

failed_third_down_review.selection: First sustained beyond-line interval, no spacing-at-release gate. Schwartz illustration plus seeded sample of other distinct plays; all qualifying receivers on selected plays, chronological order.
failed_third_down_review.definition: Third-down C/I/IN failures; excludes sacks/runs, penalties, fumbles, ambiguous scoring, no-plays, goal-to-go. >2 yd spacing >=0.5 s, at/beyond yards-to-go and >=2 yd downfield between snap+1s and release-0.3s.
